name: Agency hero: a real message exchange played at human pace with honest timestamps
notes: Signature effect: a first message from a business owner and the reply, played back at conversational pace. The restraint that makes it work is that the reply is not instant. The thread stamps 8:42 PM to 8:51 PM and the footer says 'first reply in 9 minutes', which is more persuasive than a claim of zero. Pacing is authored per message via data-wait and data-typing rather than one flat interval, because an even rhythm reads as a machine. The typing indicator is removed the moment its message lands so it is never left spinning. The whole exchange is in the markup as real text; the script only decides when each becomes visible. Also carries the series' metric pattern: a large tabular figure ('9 min') beside a dense block naming how it was measured, ending 'Not a promise. A record.' Note .metric-num needs white-space:nowrap or '9 min' breaks after the 9. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
